onbSubtitle.message: AI token usage monitoring for Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini — three quick steps to get started.

permTitle.message: Why Token Watcher asks for each permission

permIntro.message: Nothing below reads your messages. Each permission is used only for the purpose listed.

permHostsName.message: Access to claude.ai, chatgpt.com and gemini.google.com

permHostsBody.message: Lets the extension read token counts and quota figures from these three sites. It is not used on any other site.

permCookiesBody.message: Lets the extension make quota requests to your signed-in provider account without asking you to paste a key. Cookie values are never stored or sent anywhere.

permStorageBody.message: Keeps your settings and usage history on this device.

permAlarmsBody.message: Schedules periodic refreshes and pauses them while your computer is idle.

permNotificationsBody.message: Shows an alert when usage crosses a threshold you chose.

permTabsBody.message: Finds your open provider tabs and runs the usage gauge in them.

permLocalhostBody.message: Only requested if you turn on sharing with Token Watcher Core running on your own computer.

onbPrivacyBody.message: Your usage data stays on your device. Token Watcher reads token counts and quota figures only; it never reads message content and has no analytics or tracking servers. It talks only to the provider sites you use (and to localhost if you opt in).

privIntro.message: Token Watcher is local-first. This page explains what is stored, for how long, how to delete it, and what is never collected.

privLocalBody.message: Settings, per-provider quota snapshots (up to 7 days), recent token-count events (up to 2,000), and optional local analytics events (up to 90 days). All of it lives in this browser profile's extension storage.

privCloudBody.message: None. Token Watcher has no cloud sync and no servers of its own. If you opt in to sharing with Token Watcher Core, metadata-only events go to localhost:7734 on your own computer and nowhere else.

privNetBody.message: The extension contacts only claude.ai, chatgpt.com and gemini.google.com, using your existing signed-in session, to read your own quota figures.

privRetBody.message: Quota snapshots are trimmed to the last 7 days, token events to the most recent 2,000, and analytics events to 90 days. Removing the extension deletes everything it stored.

privDelBody.message: Use "Delete all analytics data" in Extension Settings to clear local analytics immediately, or remove the extension to clear all stored data.

privNever2.message: Attachments, conversation titles, or page contents

privNever3.message: Cookie values, API keys, or passwords

privNever4.message: Full URLs, or any data sold or shared with third parties

extDescription.message: Track AI token usage across Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini in real-time. Monitor session limits, view history, and get alerts before you hit your limit.
extDescription.description: Extension store description (max 132 characters is recommended by Chrome).
